heading: Definitions
lead: In this chapter, the following definitions apply:

tree.heading: Federal government.—
tree.text: The term “Federal Government” includes the government of the District of Columbia.

tree.heading: Motor vehicle.—
tree.text: The term “motor vehicle” means a vehicle, self-propelled or drawn by mechanical power, designed for use on the highways principally for the transportation of passengers, except a vehicle designed or used for military field training, combat, or tactical purposes.
